item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Car Photo in Black and White

turns.text: Make this black and white, please. Just remove the colour—don't change anything else or crop it.

item.tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

answer_sheet.Black-and-white treatment: Neutral grayscale across the whole photo, not sepia or selective colour.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: Everything except colour, including the car, street, background and full original framing.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One image in the original shape of the photo (5:3); free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
The full original composition is retained without cropping, in the photo's own shape.

dialog.agent: Sure—what would you like changed? I can change the car’s color, replace the background, remove distractions, or give it a cinematic look.
dialog.why: It asks the user what changes they want and offers options, then waits for their choice.
dialog.user: make it black and white, just remove the colour. don't change anything else or crop it.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t make the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

For this exact change in a photo editor, set **Saturation to −100** and export without cropping or resizing. That removes the colour while leaving the composition unchanged.

style.prompt: Convert the entire supplied photograph to neutral black and white (grayscale) only: remove all color saturation. Do not change anything else. Preserve the exact original composition, aspect ratio, full image boundaries and framing with no cropping, every object, car, street, houses, trees, lighting, shadows, texture and detail. No additions, removals, restyling, retouching, or contrast adjustments. Only remove the colour.
